content: When comparing between PN and PN5cls, PN5cls achieves better results than PN. This indicates that including a broader range of the context is effective for improving inference ability. Considering that the representation of IsNext and IsNextInadj should be coherent, we propose BERTBase-PNsmth to mitigate this problem. PNsmth further improves the performance and obtains an averaged score of 81.0.
